mapper.select: SELECT i.function_id FROM items i WHERE i.cognito_sub = #{cognitoSub} AND i.is_active = 1
SELECT function_id FROM functions WHERE function_key = #{functionKey} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT f.function_id, f.function_key, f.module, f.description, CASE WHEN i.cognito_sub IS NULL THEN 'NEVER_GRANTED' WHEN i.is_active = 1 THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END AS state, i.granted_by, i.created_at FROM functions f LEFT JOIN items i ON i.function_id = f.function_id AND i.cognito_sub = #{cognitoSub} WHERE f.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY f.function_id
